specification.title: Crisis leadership and high-stakes judgment
specification.outcome: Make and revise accountable crisis decisions with incomplete information.

genre: Professional institutional leadership with complete original economic/financial models and inspectable decision artifacts; no fabricated real leadership.
requirements: Two complete original academic and financial crisis leadership cases, with dated evidence releases and decisions under incomplete information. Teach triage, uncertainty, scenario-based contingent actions and accountable revision; substantive quantitative decision proof, informative versus noninformative evidence and explicit operational constraints. Complete crisis communications, decision logs, contingency and after-action artifacts, eight full solutions. Distinct from C08 ordinary capital/liquidity optimization; no invented current emergency or legal authority. Use bounded inspected primary sources for crisis concepts and fresh official sources if current duties claimed.

Read necessary accepted economic/financial/research/teaching prerequisites and canonical coverage. Use bounded inspected primary sources for unresolved claims; original models and cases. Current laws/regulations or institutional policies require fresh official dated jurisdiction-aware retrieval; do not use broad professional advice as legal authority. Reuse stable verified source scopes with original inspector attribution. No fictional evidence represented as real responsibility.
